# awstagging Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account` (String) Explicit AWS account ID to use to compute tags
- `accounts_coding` (Attributes Map) Configuration for supported AWS accounts to allow tags and names to be correctly populated. If not specified, default configuration will be used (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts_coding))
- `app_ecosystem` (String) Application/service ecosystem name. This is a coherent collection of application environments, e.g. all the microservices making up a distributed system
- `app_environment` (String) Application/service environment name. This is a logical environment, multiple logical environments can live on the same AWS account. By default gets the same value from infra_environment
- `company_name_long` (String) Name of the company, extended descripting version. This could probably become a constant...
- `company_name_short` (String) Name of the company, compact version. This could probably become a constant...
- `compliance` (String) Compliance level for a resource
- `cost_centre` (String) Cost centre identifier for billing AWS resources
- `custom_tags` (Map of String) Map of optional tags, in the form: 'TagName = TagValue'. Names are prefixed with custom prefix
- `custom_tags_verbatim` (Map of String) Map of optional tags, in the form: 'TagName = TagValue'. Names are used as specified, without custom prefix
- `description` (String) Free-text description for the resource being tagged
- `infra_environment` (String) Infrastructure environment name. This typically coincides with a VPC: this is our environment container, mutliple VPC/environments can live on the same AWS account
- `is_create_before_destroy` (Boolean) If we want to recycle a resource by creating a new instance before destroying the existing one, then names must be different otherwise the process will fail. We do this by appending a hashed value to a common name-prefix. This is an override flag of the resource type specific property
- `is_force_generated_name` (Boolean) Expliticly decide to ignore var.custom_name and automatically generate a new name (used to ease transition of resources with legacy names)
- `owner` (String) Owner/maintainer of the AWS resource being tagged
- `project_name_long` (String) Project name, extended descripting version
- `project_name_short` (String) Project name, compact version
- `region` (String) AWS region where the resource is being provisioned in
- `resource_set_long` (String) Logical name of the resource set (all the resources provisioned by a single Terraform root module), extended descripting version
- `resource_set_short` (String) Logical name of the resource set (all the resources provisioned by a single Terraform root module), compact version
- `role` (String) Role played by AWS resource in the context of its environment, e.g. database, security, ...
- `terraform_module` (String) Terraform module name used to provision this resource being tagged.
- `terraform_workspace` (String) Terraform workspace name used to provision this resource being tagged.
